name: Single-Row Extension Interval
definition: Let $D=\{00,10,01\}$ on the full two-coordinate section $S$, with its sole missing row written $(a,1-a)$.
properties: For $0<t\le1/3$, the rows extending to a $t$-certificate are exactly $2t/(1+t)\le a\le(1-t)/(1+t)$; for $t>1/3$ the extension set is empty. Every positive row extends at some positive margin, while only $a=1/2$ attains the optimum margin $1/3$.
